enum_items.name: And
enum_items.description: True when both inputs are true

enum_items.name: Or
enum_items.description: True when at least one input is true

enum_items.name: Not And
enum_items.description: True when at least one input is false

enum_items.name: Nor
enum_items.description: True when both inputs are false

enum_items.name: Equal
enum_items.description: True when both inputs are equal (exclusive nor)

enum_items.name: Not Equal
enum_items.description: True when both inputs are different (exclusive or)

enum_items.name: Imply
enum_items.description: True unless the first input is true and the second is false

enum_items.name: Subtract
enum_items.description: True when the first input is true and the second is false (not imply)
